g.text: Each chip runs sample prep, amplification and readout on a card
the size of a credit card. The numbers below come from 212 bench
runs and 14 field days, and they set the bar for the January trial.

g.text: Five steps from sample to result
The operator touches the chip twice: load the sample, then read the
result. Everything between is passive: the chip moves fluid by
Collect 20 µL of capillary blood with the integrated lancet
Close the lid: the buffer pouch bursts and lyses the sample
The chip meters the lysate into the amplification chamber
Isothermal heater runs 30 minutes at a steady 65 °C
Read the lateral-flow strip, or scan it with the phone app

g.text: What the January trial will measure
Three clinics, six weeks, and one number decides whether the chip
moves on to the regulatory study: how many of the screened patients
end up with an evaluable result on the first attempt.
